# KOHLER

> > KOHLER is a leading manufacturer of kitchen and bathroom products including smart toilets, bidet seats, faucets, sinks, and the LuxStone remodeling service.

Founded by John Michael Kohler in Wisconsin, KOHLER offers comprehensive bathroom and kitchen solutions ranging from traditional fixtures to innovative smart home products like the Numi 2.0 and Eir toilets. The company also provides the Reveal by KOHLER remodeling service featuring LuxStone showers and baths with one-day installation.

## Key Topics

- PureWash bidet seats (E930, E820, E750, E590, M300)
- LuxStone showers and walk-in baths
- Reveal by KOHLER remodeling service
- Smart home bathroom products
- Numi 2.0 and Eir smart toilets
- Heated and deodorizing toilet seats
- One-day installation services
- Lifetime warranty coverage
- Custom bathroom design
- Premium bathroom fixtures
- Kitchen and bathroom faucets
- Toilet seats and bidet technology
- Wisconsin-based manufacturing

- [Smart Home Products](https://www.smarthome.kohler.com/): Smart bathroom & kitchen products including Numi 2.0 and Eir toilets

## Remodeling Services

- [Reveal by KOHLER](https://reveal.kohler.com/): LuxStone shower & bath remodeling service with one-day installation
